description: This file contains shell script functions related to firmware upgrade and dual boot management for specific hardware boards. It includes functions to set boot partitions, perform dual boot upgrades, and manage environment variables for firmware flashing.

methods.name: set_boot_part
methods.description: Configures environment variables and boot parameters based on the target partition and hardware board.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_dualboot_plasmacloud
methods.description: Performs the dual boot firmware upgrade process, including selecting the inactive firmware slot, extracting files, writing to flash, and updating environment settings.
